name: Bubblewrap
author: Henrik Zenkert
description: Pop the bubbles bouncing around the room by shooting upward as you move along the floor. Left and right to move, Up to shoot.

descriptions.en: Pop the bubbles bouncing around the room by shooting upward as you move along the floor. Left and right to move, Up to shoot.
descriptions.it: Fai scoppiare le bolle che rimbalzano nella stanza sparando verso l'alto mentre ti muovi sul pavimento. Sinistra e destra per muoverti, su per sparare.
